(2) The toddler stands up and begins pushing the toy mop around the room. The setting is an indoor space that looks like a combination of a home and a workspace, with white cabinets, a desk, and a modern white office chair. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from an unseen window. (3) The camera follows the toddler as she mops under a desk and then towards a doorway leading to a hallway. She looks down at the floor intently, periodically stopping to adjust her grip on the toy's handle. She eventually mops her way into a hallway with a glass-paned door. (4) The toddler reaches a tiled entrance area and mops there briefly. She then stops, picks up the mop handle, and looks back toward the camera as if finished with her task. The video ends with a pink transition screen showing a cartoon illustration and text.
